<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תשרי_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518914390_theRebbe_977" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_A9_D7_A8_D7_99_meluket__BH_POST_1766518914390_theRebbe_977__p001">
  <section v="0">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Introductory heading for the maamar.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">With the help of Heaven.</t>
    <t s="1">The second day of the festival of Sukkos.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="1">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The Rebbe explains the distinction between "I caused Bnei Yisrael to dwell in sukkos" and "you shall dwell in sukkos," and how the former empowers the latter.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">"You shall dwell in sukkos for seven days; every citizen in Israel shall dwell in sukkos, so that your generations may know that I caused Bnei Yisrael to dwell in sukkos when I brought them out of the land of Egypt."</t>
    <t s="1">And my revered father-in-law, the Rebbe, precisely notes in his maamar beginning with the words "This"</t>
    <t s="2">(in the continuation of Rosh HaShanah 5703),</t>
    <t s="3">that "I caused Bnei Yisrael to dwell in sukkos" means that the Holy One, blessed be He, caused Bnei Yisrael to dwell in sukkos,</t>
    <t s="4">while "you shall dwell in sukkos" is a command to Yisrael that they themselves should dwell in sukkos,</t>
    <t s="5">meaning that they should dwell in sukkos by their own power,</t>
    <t s="6">and nevertheless he says that "I caused Bnei Yisrael to dwell in sukkos" is a reason for "you shall dwell in sukkos,"</t>
    <t s="7">for since the Holy One, blessed be He, caused Bnei Yisrael to dwell in sukkos</t>
    <t s="8">[a matter that is only in the bosom of the Creator]</t>
    <t s="9">therefore they are able and obligated to dwell in sukkos by their own power.</t>
    <t s="10">And it may be said</t>
    <t s="11">that in the precise wording of the maamar there are two matters.</t>
    <t s="12">For since "I caused Bnei Yisrael to dwell in sukkos" is in the bosom of the Creator, how can the created being resemble the Creator?</t>
    <t s="13">And also,</t>
    <t s="14">from the fact that it says a reason for "you shall dwell in sukkos"</t>
    <t s="15">("for I caused Bnei Yisrael to dwell in sukkos")</t>
    <t s="16">it is proven that in order for Yisrael to be able to dwell in sukkos, it is not by their own power but rather through the granting of power from above,</t>
    <t s="17">and nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="18">after the Holy One, blessed be He, caused Bnei Yisrael to dwell in sukkos</t>
    <t s="19">(when He brought them out of the land of Egypt)</t>
    <t s="20">they are able to dwell in the sukkah by their own power.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="2">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The explanation is that the sukkah draws down encompassing lights, and the divine arousal of "I caused them to dwell" enables the human work of settling these lights internally.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And the point of the explanation of this</t>
    <t s="1">(in the maamar),</t>
    <t s="2">is that in the sukkah, encompassing lights are drawn down,</t>
    <t s="3">and through dwelling in the sukkah, they are drawn into inwardness and become settled lights.</t>
    <t s="4">And this is that "you shall dwell in sukkos" is through the granting of power from above,</t>
    <t s="5">for the encompassing lights</t>
    <t s="6">(as they are in themselves)</t>
    <t s="7">are the opposite of settlement,</t>
    <t s="8">and in order for there to be "you shall dwell in sukkos"—that through Yisrael dwelling in the sukkah they draw the encompassing lights into inwardness,</t>
    <t s="9">and moreover,</t>
    <t s="10">that they become settled lights—this is through "I caused Bnei Yisrael to dwell in sukkos,"</t>
    <t s="11">that the Holy One, blessed be He, caused Bnei Yisrael to dwell in sukkos,</t>
    <t s="12">an arousal from above.</t>
    <t s="13">And what is said "you shall dwell in sukkos," whose meaning is</t>
    <t s="14">(as above)</t>
    <t s="15">that Yisrael will draw the encompassing lights into inwardness by their own power,</t>
    <t s="16">this is</t>
    <t s="17">because this that "I caused Bnei Yisrael to dwell in sukkos" in the manner of an arousal from above was from the outset intended so that through this there would be "you shall dwell in sukkos" through service by their own power.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
